text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Testicular Torsion. The patient is a 16-year-old male presenting with sudden-onset scrotal and lower abdominal pain following physical activity, and the ultrasound findings of decreased blood flow to the right testicle combined with a horizontal lie and absent cremasteric reflex are diagnostic. Immediate surgical exploration is required to salvage the testicle.
